scope: AttoLang-native syntax with Pony-inspired safety; do not introduce Pony keywords as language aliases

mapping.iso: rt take transfers the entire exclusive object graph; source capability invalidated only after admission
mapping.trn: uniquely mutable construction owner may be deep-frozen; no direct send while local read aliases remain
mapping.ref: actor-local mutable reference; never cross an actor boundary
mapping.val: rt share on a PROVED deeply immutable reachable object graph; permanent freeze, not revocable read-only loan
mapping.box: rt borrow read-only local loan; cannot send between actors just because it cannot write
mapping.tag: opaque actor/object identity; no read/write/host capability, actor messaging requires separate authorization
mapping.recover: checked graph isolation construction region; outer references restricted to safe immutables, opaque tags, or consumed isolated graph

graph_invariants: checked transfer/freeze is transitive over every reachable edge, not just the root
mutable object edges cannot point to independently writable external graphs under the pretense of isolation
cycles within the exclusive graph may freeze safely after a full reachability proof
temporary borrowed read view is never equivalent to permanent globally immutable val
failed mailbox admission preserves sender owner, graph version, native charge, and receiver state
successful admitted same-tenant take revokes all sender authorities, increments graph version, and queues exactly one new owner token
cross-tenant move must use broker-authorized deep copy/serialization, no raw pointer or mutable graph alias transfer
immutable frozen graphs may be read by multiple same-tenant actors, never written or thawed
revoked, forged, stale-generation and guessed tokens fail; actor ID strings are not authority
actor tag permits only authorized messaging; no state field access or privileged system actions
recover forbids mutable outer captures and escape of mutable aliases, including through cycles
no mutable borrow or other unpinned loan crosses actor await/select, critical region or retirement
tenant or actor revocation must invalidate all derived capabilities and pending transfers
zero-copy graph transfer is permitted only within a validated same-tenant memory domain; never implied by a host model

delivery.admission: linearization point is atomically coupled to owner-token invalidation on success
delivery.failure: typed MailboxFull or StaleHandle; sender retains owner on full or denied admission
delivery.supervisor: CONTROL is independent of ordinary data capacity, cannot be intercepted by failing actor

evidence_limits: Reference table and finite model cannot demonstrate a compiler's viewpoint adaptation or borrow checker.
No Pony source to Pony binary translation is required or implied.
LLVM and GraalVM restricted source AOT experiments are not a full Pony-style graph transfer implementation.
No full five-backend compiled guest proofs, hostile tenant security, long-lived zero-GC heap bounds, or actor scheduler equivalence.
